raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The stale-event filter added under DE-412 (ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours) drops legitimate POSTED transactions. Source batches routinely arrive about 3 days after txn_ts, so roughly 20-25% of each batch from batch 3 onward is lost. txn_id is fully distinct, so there are no duplicates that would justify dropping rows. The fix is to remove the lateness filter and keep the status filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.65,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
